quality_gates: Every CompassKC application has a unique numeric ID, exact name, category, and deterministic portal URL.
Every permit category resolves to at least one cited category-rule family.
Selecting electrical returns all eight electrical permit candidates before project-fact narrowing.
Electrical service size, voltage, solar, generator, battery, fire pump, transformer, wind turbine, ATS, reconnect, limited-service, fire-alarm, and security-alarm branches are encoded.
Vector retrieval is non-authoritative and cannot add, remove, or classify required permits.
All 45 canonical approvals have exact, cited review-rule coverage and every source ID resolves to an official URL.
All 423 external-assessment items are dispositioned; every retained or corrected item has a complete executable evidence path, and excluded items retain a reason.
All 196 exact Compass permit and plan workflows remain visible, have a user-facing applicability question, and have at least 10 evidence-gated checks.
Every selected rule receives exactly one traceable result; missing documents, context, model output, or external evidence returns not verified.
Source records point to official Kansas City or codified-law pages.
